integrity: All scientific claims are stated with exact quantifiers and limits; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Whole-model induced-submodel public announcements of a fixed atomic proposition, with empty results permitted.
No claim for arbitrary announcing formulas, pointwise executability, arrow-deleting actions, or non-S5 frames.
The enumeration and its exponential generating function already appear in OEIS A367888; novel content is the epistemic semantic interpretation and structural classification.
The proof treats arbitrary carriers; finite program executions only corroborate the finite cases.
Possible equivalent older theorem under different terminology cannot be excluded.
title: Order independence of knowing-whether announcements on arbitrary S5 frames
